description:
Fix ANR on the car: add car-app-api.level to the APK root (androidx.car.app reads it via ClassLoader; without it getAppInfo() threw and the host reported ANR). Also: tweaker now warms up Play Store automatically (deviceidle whitelist + starts PlayGearheadService) — no need to open the Play Store manually.

- **Android Auto**: injects PetalCarAppService and projects the built-in HiCar automotive UI (AutoPetalMapsActivity) onto the head-unit surface via VirtualDisplay, with synthetic pan/zoom/recenter gestures.
- **Anti-Repack Bypass**: neutralises the native SecurityDetect.irpj() integrity check that kills the process on re-signed APKs.
- **Manufacturer Check Bypass**: removes the Huawei/Honor-only device gate.
- **Change package name**: install alongside the original app (default: morphe.huawei.petal.maps).
